An '''Unidentified male Human inmate''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gangster/Legends|criminal]] that was sentenced to a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] term in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]]. In [[44 ABY]], he and several comrades, under the orders of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] thief [[Furan]] confronted former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]], who was sentenced to the same prison. He was soundly beaten by the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].
